bento.heading: Built for Lexical
bento.subheading: Deeply embedded in Lexical and works reliably as the document tree updates

items.answer: Yes. Velt anchors each comment to a node in the Lexical tree and rebases that anchor as the surrounding content is edited. Comments stay attached to the right text even after multi-user edits, formatting changes, or block reflows.
items.question: Will comments stay attached as the document tree updates?

items.answer: Yes. The Velt Lexical integration composes alongside your own custom nodes without overriding their schema, commands, or transforms. You can keep using any custom nodes you already have.
items.question: Does this support custom Lexical nodes?

items.answer: Yes. The comments package can be installed and used standalone, without enabling presence, cursors, or multiplayer editing.
items.question: Can I use comments only?

items.answer: No. Velt provides a fully managed collaboration backend for comments, presence, and persistence — no server to run.
items.question: Do I need a backend?

items.answer: Pricing is based on Monthly Active Collaborators who actively use Velt features, not raw connections or messages.
